lines.text: 옛날에 진짜 공주와 결혼하고 싶은 왕자가 있었어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, there was a prince who wanted to marry a true princess.
segs: Once upon a time, there was a prince who wanted to marry a true princess.

lines.text: 배를 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the boat.

lines.text: 왕자는 배를 타고 온 세상을 돌아다녔어요.
lines.en: The prince sailed all around the world on his boat.
segs: The prince sailed all around the world on his boat.

lines.text: 온 세상을 다 가 봤지만, 진짜 공주인지 알 수 없었어요.
lines.en: I went all around the world, but I could never tell if a princess was a true princess.
segs: I went all around the world, but I could never tell if a princess was a true princess.

lines.text: 그날 밤, 비가 쏟아지고 천둥이 우르릉!
lines.en: That night, the rain poured down and the thunder went rumble, rumble!
segs: That night, the rain poured down and the thunder went rumble, rumble!

lines.text: 누가 성문을 똑똑, 두드려요.
lines.en: Someone was knocking at the castle gate. Knock, knock.
segs: Someone was knocking at the castle gate. Knock, knock.

lines.text: 성문을 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the gate.

lines.text: 이 밤에 누구지?
lines.en: Who could it be at this hour?
segs: Who could it be at this hour?

lines.text: 비를 맞았지만 괜찮아요. 저는 진짜 공주예요!
lines.en: I got caught in the rain, but I'm all right. I am a true princess!
segs: I got caught in the rain, but I'm all right. I am a true princess!

lines.text: 어서 들어와 몸을 말리렴.
lines.en: Come in, dear, and dry yourself off.
segs: Come in, dear, and dry yourself off.

lines.text: 진짜 공주인지는… 살짝 알아볼까?
lines.en: A true princess, hmm? Let's find out... just a little.
segs: A true princess, hmm? Let's find out... just a little.

lines.text: 왕비님은 손님방에 완두콩 한 알, 베개, 매트리스 한 장을 가져왔어요.
lines.en: The queen brought one pea, a pillow and a mattress into the guest room.
segs: The queen brought one pea, a pillow and a mattress into the guest room.

lines.text: 셋 중에서 제일 작은 것은 뭘까요? 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Which of the three is the smallest? Tap it.
segs: Which of the three is the smallest? Tap it.

lines.text: 그건 베개예요. 더 작은 걸 찾아봐요.
lines.en: That's the pillow. Look for something smaller.
segs: That's the pillow. Look for something smaller.

lines.text: 그건 매트리스예요. 더 작은 걸 찾아봐요.
lines.en: That's the mattress. Look for something smaller.
segs: That's the mattress. Look for something smaller.

lines.text: 맞아요, 완두콩이 제일 작아요!
lines.en: That's right, the pea is the smallest!
segs: That's right, the pea is the smallest!

lines.text: 그럼 제일 큰 것은 뭘까요? 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Then which one is the biggest? Tap it.
segs: Then which one is the biggest? Tap it.

lines.text: 그건 완두콩이에요. 더 큰 걸 찾아봐요.
lines.en: That's the pea. Look for something bigger.
segs: That's the pea. Look for something bigger.

lines.text: 그건 베개예요. 더 큰 걸 찾아봐요.
lines.en: That's the pillow. Look for something bigger.
segs: That's the pillow. Look for something bigger.

lines.text: 맞아요, 매트리스가 제일 커요!
lines.en: That's right, the mattress is the biggest!
segs: That's right, the mattress is the biggest!

lines.text: 요 조그만 완두콩 한 알을 침대 판자에 톡. 아무도 못 본 척!
lines.en: This tiny little pea goes on the bed board, tap. Nobody saw a thing!
segs: This tiny little pea goes on the bed board, tap. Nobody saw a thing!

lines.text: 완두콩 위에 매트리스를 쌓아 볼까? 몇 장일까요? 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Shall we pile mattresses on top of the pea? How many will there be? Tap!
segs: Shall we pile mattresses on top of the pea? How many will there be? Tap!

lines.text: 열! 아직 더 있어요. 한 번 더 톡!
lines.en: Ten! And there are still more. Tap once more!
segs: Ten! And there are still more. Tap once more!

lines.text: 스물! 매트리스가 스무 장이에요.
lines.en: Twenty! That makes twenty mattresses.

lines.text: 이불도 스무 장, 푹신푹신!
lines.en: And twenty feather quilts on top, soft and fluffy!
segs: And twenty feather quilts on top, soft and fluffy!

lines.text: 완두콩은 어디 있을까요? 탑의 위? 아래?
lines.en: Where is the pea? At the top of the tower, or at the bottom?
segs: Where is the pea? At the top of the tower, or at the bottom?

lines.text: 거긴 탑의 위예요. 완두콩은 맨 아래에 있어요. 아래를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: That's the top of the tower. The pea is at the very bottom. Tap the bottom.
segs: That's the top of the tower. The pea is at the very bottom. Tap the bottom.

lines.text: 맞아요! 완두콩은 맨 아래에 있어요.
lines.en: That's right! The pea is at the very bottom.
segs: That's right! The pea is at the very bottom.

lines.text: 공주님은 어디서 잘까요? 위? 아래?
lines.en: Where will the princess sleep? At the top, or at the bottom?
segs: Where will the princess sleep? At the top, or at the bottom?

lines.text: 거긴 탑의 아래예요. 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요. 위를 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: That's the bottom of the tower. The princess sleeps at the very top. Tap the top.
segs: That's the bottom of the tower. The princess sleeps at the very top. Tap the top.

lines.text: 맞아요! 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요.
lines.en: That's right! The princess sleeps at the very top.
segs: That's right! The princess sleeps at the very top.

lines.text: 완두콩은 맨 아래, 공주님은 맨 위에서 자요.
lines.en: The pea at the very bottom, and the princess at the very top.
segs: The pea at the very bottom, and the princess at the very top.

lines.text: 와, 높다! 잘 자요.
lines.en: Wow, it's so high! Good night.
segs: Wow, it's so high! Good night.

lines.text: 밤이 깊었는데… 공주는 이리 뒤척, 저리 뒤척.
lines.en: Late into the night... the princess tossed this way, and turned that way.
segs: Late into the night... the princess tossed this way, and turned that way.

lines.text: 뭔가 딱딱한 게 있는 것 같아…
lines.en: I think there's something hard in here...
segs: I think there's something hard in here...

lines.text: 아침이 되었어요. 공주가 사다리를 내려왔어요.
lines.en: Morning came. The princess climbed down the ladder.
segs: Morning came. The princess climbed down the ladder.

lines.text: 잘 잤니?
lines.en: Did you sleep well?

lines.text: 아니요, 솔직히 한숨도 못 잤어요. 뭔가 딱딱한 게 있어서 몸이 뻐근하고 졸려요.
lines.en: No. To be honest, I didn't sleep a wink. Something hard was in the bed, and now I'm stiff and sleepy.
segs: No. To be honest, I didn't sleep a wink. Something hard was in the bed, and now I'm stiff and sleepy.

lines.text: 매트리스 스무 장 아래 완두콩을 느끼다니! 진짜 공주로구나!
lines.en: She felt the pea through twenty mattresses! She is a true princess!
segs: She felt the pea through twenty mattresses! She is a true princess!

lines.text: 왕자와 공주는 손을 꼭 잡았어요.
lines.en: The prince and the princess held hands tight.
segs: The prince and the princess held hands tight.

lines.text: 진짜 공주님을 드디어 찾았어요!
lines.en: At last, I have found a true princess!
segs: At last, I have found a true princess!

lines.text: 완두콩은 박물관에 갔대요.
lines.en: And the pea was sent to a museum.
segs: And the pea was sent to a museum.

lines.text: 유리 상자를 톡 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the glass case.

lines.text: 안녕!
lines.en: Bye-bye!

ui.느낀 것을 솔직하게 말하는 마음이 진짜 공주의 마음이에요: Saying honestly what you feel is the heart of a true princess
